EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\\n\"\n        \"G1 X100 Y100 Z0.2\\n\"\n        \"G1 X150 Y150 Z0.2\\n\"\n        \"G1 X150 Y150 Z20\\n\"\n        + end_block\n        + \"; EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\\n\"\n    )\n\n\ndef test_parse_extracts_four_boxes():\n    boxes = parse_end_block(_gcode(\"; MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\\nG1 Z30 F600\\nG1 Y-0.5 F6000\\n\"))\n    assert set(boxes) >= {\"toolhead\", \"gantry\", \"bed\", \"stl\"}\n    assert boxes[\"stl\"][\"max\"][2] == 20\n\n\ndef test_collision_flagged():\n    result = simulate_end_block(_gcode(\";   "changes": {
    "README.md": "# Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\n\nA small web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only)**: upload one\npart, choose how many times it should print (N), and get back a native\n`.gcode.3mf` that prints the part N times, pushing each finished part off the bed\nbetween iterations (Factorian Designs method).\n\n* `autoeject/` - pure-Python core (STL checks, G-code end block, .gcode.3mf loop, motion sim).\n* `app/` - FastAPI app + single static page (`app/static/index.html`, no build step).\n* `profiles/a1_end.gcode` - the eject template (BambuStudio placeholders are evaluated before anything is written).\n* `fixtures/` - `cube.stl` and a real Bambu Studio A1 export `real_a1.gcode.3mf` (20.08 mm part, 72 layers).\n\n## API\n\n| Method | Path | In | Out |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| POST | `/api/check` | multipart STL (`file`) | JSON `{verdict, reasons, metrics}` |\n| POST | `/api/slice` | multipart STL (`file`), `n`, `bed_heat_temp`, `bed_heat_hold`, `bed_cool_temp`, `bed_cool_hold`, `cycle_count` | `.gcode.3mf` |\n| POST | `/api/fallback` | multipart `.gcode.3mf` (`file`), same eject params | `.gcode.3mf` |\n\nA `fail` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 with the reasons); `warn` is\nreported in the `X-Eject-Verdict` / `X-Eject-Reasons` response headers and never\nblocks. `X-Eject-Sim` carries the end-block simulation (boxes, path, collision /\nmissed-push flags) used by the browser preview. There is no printer parameter\nanywhere: the machine profile is always `Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle`.\n\n## Run locally\n\n```bash\n# 1. install (Python 3.13 + uv)\nuv sync\n\n# 2. run the app\nuv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n# open http://127.0.0.1:8000\n```\n\nSlicing uses the Bambu Studio CLI, so point the app at it:\n\n```bash\nexport BAMBU_CLI=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/BambuStudio\nexport BAMBU_PROFILES=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\n```\n\n`/api/fallback` and `/api/check` work without the CLI; `/api/slice` answers\n`503` with a clear message when `BAMBU_CLI` is missing or not runnable.\n\n### Exporting a sliced file from Bambu Studio\n\nTo use the fallback path (recommended: slice in the GUI with your own A1\nsettings, then let the app swap the stock end block for the eject block):\n\n1. Open Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle** printer, load your\n   part and slice it.\n2. Menu **File -> Export -> Export plate sliced file** (this writes a\n   `*.gcode.3mf`, not a plain `.gcode`).\n3. Upload that `.gcode.3mf` on the page, set N and the heat/cool params, and\n   download the patched file.\n\n### Tests\n\n```bash\nuv run pytest -q\n```\n\nThe tests never need a printer, the network, or the real Bambu Studio binary:\nthe slicer CLI is faked, and every module that reads or writes `.gcode.3mf` is\nexercised against `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`.\n\n## Deploy\n\n`railway.toml` starts `uv run --no-dev uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`\n(health check `/`). `Dockerfile` is provided for images where a pinned\nBambu Studio CLI is installed; set `BAMBU_CLI` / `BAMBU_PROFILES` accordingly.\n",
    "app/main.py": "\"\"\"FastAPI app: check an STL, slice it, or patch an already-sliced .gcode.3mf.\n\nBambu Lab A1 only (256 x 256 mm bed).  There is deliberately **no** printer\nparameter anywhere: the machine profile is a constant inside ``autoeject``.\n\nEndpoints (all synchronous, multipart field ``file``, iteration count ``n``):\n\n* ``POST /api/check``    -> JSON ``{verdict, reasons, metrics}``\n* ``POST /api/slice``    -> ``.gcode.3mf`` (STL in)\n* ``POST /api/fallback`` -> ``.gcode.3mf`` (already-sliced ``.gcode.3mf`` in)\n\nPipelines wired to the real ``autoeject`` functions::\n\n    STL          -> check -> build_end_block -> slice_stl -> loop_3mf\n    .gcode.3mf   -> build_end_block -> inject_end_block -> loop_3mf\n\nA ``fail`` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 + reasons); ``warn`` is\nreported to the UI through response headers and never blocks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse, Response\nfrom fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\n\nfrom autoeject import (\n    build_end_block,\n    check,\n    inject_end_block,\n    loop_3mf,\n    simulate_end_block,\n    slice_stl,\n)\nfrom autoeject.slicer import EndBlockError, SlicerUnavailable, read_gcode_3mf\nfrom autoeject.stl import bounds\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\nTEMPLATE_PATH = ROOT / \"profiles\" / \"a1_end.gcode\"\nSTATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\"\n\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\", version=\"0.1.0\")\napp.mount(\"/static\", StaticFiles(directory=str(STATIC_DIR)), name=\"static\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# form helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef _template() -> str:\n    return TEMPLATE_PATH.read_text()\n\n\ndef _num(value, default: float) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``\"60 \u00b0C\"`` / ``\"60 s\"`` / ``\"60\"`` into a number.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r\"-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\", str(value))\n    return float(match.group(0)) if match else float(default)\n\n\ndef _params(bed_heat_temp, bed_heat_hold, bed_cool_temp, bed_cool_hold,\n            cycle_count) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Numeric eject params (gantry/nozzle push stay non-editable defaults).\"\"\"\n    return {\n        \"bed_heat_temp\": _num(bed_heat_temp, 60),\n        \"bed_heat_hold\": _num(bed_heat_hold, 60),\n        \"bed_cool_temp\": _num(bed_cool_temp, 25),\n        \"bed_cool_hold\": _num(bed_cool_hold, 120),\n        \"cycle_count\": max(1, int(_num(cycle_count, 3))),\n    }\n\n\ndef _resolve_n(n, N) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Iteration count; ``n`` is the spec field, ``N`` kept for older clients.\"\"\"\n    raw = n if n is not None else N\n    if raw is None or str(raw).strip() == \"\":\n        return 1\n    value = int(_num(raw, 1))\n    if value < 1:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"n must be >= 1\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _gate(stl_bytes: bytes) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Run the ejectability check; a ``fail`` verdict blocks the download.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        report = check(stl_bytes)\n    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f\"could not read STL: {exc}\") from exc\n    if report[\"verdict\"] == \"fail\":\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=400,\n            detail={\n                \"error\": \"part is not ejectable\",\n                \"verdict\": report[\"verdict\"],\n                \"reason\": report[\"reason\"],\n                \"reasons\": report[\"reasons\"],\n                \"metrics\": report[\"metrics\"],\n            },\n        )\n    return report\n\n\ndef _verdict_headers(report: dict) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"X-Eject-Verdict\": str(report[\"verdict\"]),\n        \"X-Eject-Reasons\": json.dumps(report[\"reasons\"], ensure_ascii=True),\n        \"X-Eject-Metrics\": json.dumps(report[\"metrics\"], ensure_ascii=True),\n    }\n\n\ndef _sim_headers(data: bytes) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Simulation result for the browser preview (best effort, never fatal).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        sim = simulate_end_block(read_gcode_3mf(data))\n    except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - preview must not break a download\n        return {}\n    return {\"X-Eject-Sim\": json.dumps(sim, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=True)}\n\n\ndef _attachment(data: bytes, name: str = \"a1_eject.gcode.3mf\",\n                headers: dict | None = None) -> Response:\n    merged = {\"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{name}\"'}\n    merged.update(headers or {})\n    return Response(content=data, media_type=\"application/octet-stream\",\n                    headers=merged)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# routes\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n@app.get(\"/\")\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n    return FileResponse(str(STATIC_DIR / \"index.html\"))\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check\")\nasync def api_check(file: UploadFile = File(...)) -> JSONResponse:\n    \"\"\"STL in, ``{verdict, reasons, metrics}`` out.\"\"\"\n    stl = await file.read()\n    try:\n        report = check(stl)\n    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f\"could not read STL: {exc}\") from exc\n    return JSONResponse(report)\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/slice\")\nasync def api_slice(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    n: str | None = Form(None),\n    N: str | None = Form(None),\n    bed_heat_temp: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_heat_hold: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_cool_temp: str = Form(\"25\"),\n    bed_cool_hold: str = Form(\"120\"),\n    cycle_count: str = Form(\"3\"),\n) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"STL -> check -> build_end_block -> slice_stl -> loop_3mf -> .gcode.3mf.\"\"\"\n    count = _resolve_n(n, N)\n    stl = await file.read()\n    report = _gate(stl)\n\n    try:\n        max_layer_z = float(bounds(stl)[\"size\"][2])\n    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f\"could not read STL: {exc}\") from exc\n\n    block = build_end_block(\n        _template(), max_layer_z,\n        _params(bed_heat_temp, bed_heat_hold, bed_cool_temp, bed_cool_hold, cycle_count),\n    )\n    try:\n        data = slice_stl(stl, block)\n    except SlicerUnavailable as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    except EndBlockError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    try:\n        if count > 1:\n            data = loop_3mf(data, count)\n    except EndBlockError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    headers = _verdict_headers(report)\n    headers.update(_sim_headers(data))\n    return _attachment(data, headers=headers)\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/fallback\")\nasync def api_fallback(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    n: str | None = Form(None),\n    N: str | None = Form(None),\n    bed_heat_temp: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_heat_hold: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_cool_temp: str = Form(\"25\"),\n    bed_cool_hold: str = Form(\"120\"),\n    cycle_count: str = Form(\"3\"),\n) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"Pre-sliced .gcode.3mf -> build_end_block -> inject_end_block -> loop_3mf.\"\"\"\n    count = _resolve_n(n, N)\n    src = await file.read()\n    params = _params(bed_heat_temp, bed_heat_hold, bed_cool_temp, bed_cool_hold,\n                     cycle_count)\n    try:\n        # build_end_block runs inside inject_end_block: max_layer_z is filled\n        # from the file's own \"; max_z_height\" header before rendering.\n        data = inject_end_block(src, _template(), params)\n        if count > 1:\n            data = loop_3mf(data, count)\n    except EndBlockError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n\n    return _attachment(data, headers=_sim_headers(data))\n",
    "app/static/index.html": "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\" />\n<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />\n<title>Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject</title>\n<!-- Pinned CDN libraries, no build step. -->\n<script src=\"https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.min.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lil-gui@0.19.2/dist/lil-gui.umd.min.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gcode-preview@2.18.0/dist/gcode-preview.js\"></script>\n<style>\n  :root { color-scheme: light dark; background: #e74c3c22; }\n  #verdict ul { margin: .35rem 0 0 1.1rem; padding: 0; }\n  #three-view { width: 100%; height: 420px; border: 1px solid #8884; border-radius: 8px;\n                background: #0b0d12; display: block; }\n  #gcode-preview { width: 100%; height: 220px; border: 1px solid #8884; border-radius: 8px;\n                   background: #0b0d12; display: block; margin-top: .75rem; }\n  .legend { display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: .8rem; margin: .5rem 0; }\n  .swatch { display: inline-block; width: .8rem; height: .8rem; border-radius: 2px; margin-right: .3rem; }\n  #download { margin-top: .75rem; }\n  .row { display: flex; gap: .6rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<h1>Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject</h1>\n<p class=\"muted\">Loop N prints of one part, pushing each finished part off the 256 &times; 256 mm bed\n(Factorian Designs method). A1 only.</p>\n\n<div class=\"layout\">\n  <form id=\"form\" autocomplete=\"off\">\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>Part</legend>\n      <label for=\"file\">STL, or an already sliced .gcode.3mf</label>\n      <input type=\"file\" id=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\".stl,.gcode.3mf,.3mf\" />\n      <p class=\"muted\" id=\"mode\">Choose a file: <b>.stl</b> is sliced here, <b>.gcode.3mf</b> is patched.</p>\n\n      <label for=\"n\">Number of prints (n)</label>\n      <input type=\"number\" id=\"n\" name=\"n\" value=\"2\" min=\"1\" step=\"1\" />\n    </fieldset>\n\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>Bed heat / cool loop</legend>\n      <div class=\"grid2\">\n        <div>\n          <label for=\"bed_heat_temp\">Heat temp (&deg;C)</label>\n          <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_heat_temp\" name=\"bed_heat_temp\" value=\"60\" step=\"1\" />\n        </div>\n        <div>\n          <label for=\"bed_heat_hold\">Heat hold (s)</label>\n          <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_heat_hold\" name=\"bed_heat_hold\" value=\"60\" step=\"1\" />\n        </div>\n        <div>\n          <label for=\"bed_cool_temp\">Cool temp (&deg;C)</label>\n          <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_cool_temp\" name=\"bed_cool_temp\" value=\"25\" step=\"1\" />\n        </div>\n        <div>\n          <label for=\"bed_cool_hold\">Cool hold (s)</label>\n          <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_cool_hold\" name=\"bed_cool_hold\" value=\"120\" step=\"1\" />\n        </div>\n        <div>\n          <label for=\"cycle_count\">Cycles per print</label>\n          <input type=\"number\" id=\"cycle_count\" name=\"cycle_count\" value=\"3\" min=\"1\" step=\"1\" />\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"fixed\">Fixed (not editable): gantry_push_z 50 mm &middot; nozzle_push_z 1 mm &middot;\n        push_feed 6000 mm/min &middot; max_layer_z_threshold 41 mm</p>\n    </fieldset>\n\n    <div class=\"row\">\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"check\" class=\"secondary\" disabled>Check ejectability</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"generate\" disabled>Generate .gcode.3mf</button>\n    </div>\n    <button type=\"button\" id=\"download\" disabled>Download .gcode.3mf</button>\n  </form>\n\n  <section>\n    <div id=\"verdict\" class=\"muted\">No part loaded yet.</div>\n    <div class=\"legend\">\n      <span><i class=\"swatch\" style=\"background:#2ecc71\"></i>STL part box</span>\n      <span><i class=\"swatch\" style=\"background:#f39c12\"></i>toolhead</span>\n      <span><i class=\"swatch\" style=\"background:#9b59b6\"></i>gantry</span>\n      <span><i class=\"swatch\" style=\"background:#3498db\"></i>bed (256 &times; 256)</span>\n    </div>\n    <canvas id=\"three-view\"></canvas>\n    <canvas id=\"gcode-preview\"></canvas>\n    <p class=\"muted\" id=\"sim-note\">End-block replay appears after generating.</p>\n  </section>\n</div>\n\n<script>\n(() => {\n  \"use strict\";\n  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);\n  const fileInput = $(\"file\");\n  const state = { file: null, kind: null, blob: null, name: \"a1_eject.gcode.3mf\", sim: null };\n\n  const verdictBox = $(\"verdict\");\n  const simNote = $(\"sim-note\");\n\n  function setVerdict(verdict, reasons, metrics) {\n    verdictBox.className = verdict || \"muted\";\n    const title = { pass: \"PASS\", warn: \"WARN\", fail: \"FAIL\" }[verdict] || \"INFO\";\n    const list = (reasons || []).map((r) => `<li>${r}</li>`).join(\"\");\n    const m = metrics || {};\n    const extra = m.height_mm !== undefined\n      ? `<div class=\"muted\">height ${m.height_mm} mm &middot; base area ${m.base_area_mm2} mm&sup2; &middot; tip-over ${m.tip_over_ratio}</div>`\n      : \"\";\n    verdictBox.innerHTML = `<b>${title}</b>${list ? `<ul>${list}</ul>` : \"\"}${extra}`;\n  }\n\n  fileInput.addEventListener(\"change\", () => {\n    const f = fileInput.files[0] || null;\n    state.file = f;\n    state.kind = f ? (f.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(\".stl\") ? \"stl\" : \"3mf\") : null;\n    $(\"check\").disabled = state.kind !== \"stl\";\n    $(\"generate\").disabled = !f;\n    state.blob = null;\n    $(\"download\").disabled = true;\n    $(\"mode\").innerHTML = f\n      ? (state.kind === \"stl\"\n        ? \"STL selected: checked, sliced with the A1 profile, then looped.\"\n        : \".gcode.3mf selected: the stock end block is replaced and looped (fallback).\")\n      : \"Choose a file: <b>.stl</b> is sliced here, <b>.gcode.3mf</b> is patched.\";\n  });\n\n  function formData() {\n    const fd = new FormData();\n    fd.append(\"file\", state.file, state.file.name);\n    for (const name of [\"n\", \"bed_heat_temp\", \"bed_heat_hold\", \"bed_cool_temp\",\n                        \"bed_cool_hold\", \"cycle_count\"]) {\n      fd.append(name, $(name).value);\n    }\n    return fd;\n  }\n\n  $(\"check\").addEventListener(\"click\", async () => {\n    if (!state.file) return;\n    setVerdict(null, [\"checking\u2026\"]);\n    try {\n      const r = await fetch(\"/api/check\", { method: \"POST\", body: formData() });\n      const body = await r.json();\n      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(body.detail || \"check failed\");\n      setVerdict(body.verdict, body.reasons, body.metrics);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setVerdict(\"fail\", [String(err.message || err)]);\n    }\n  });\n\n  $(\"generate\").addEventListener(\"click\", async () => {\n    if (!state.file) return;\n    const path = state.kind === \"stl\" ? \"/api/slice\" : \"/api/fallback\";\n    setVerdict(null, [\"generating\u2026\"]);\n    $(\"generate\").disabled = true;\n    try {\n      const r = await fetch(path, { method: \"POST\", body: formData() });\n      if (!r.ok) {\n        let detail = \"request failed (\" + r.status + \")\";\n        let reasons = [];\n        try {\n          const body = await r.json();\n          if (body.detail && typeof body.detail === \"object\") {\n            detail = body.detail.error || detail;\n            reasons = body.detail.reasons || (body.detail.reason ? [body.detail.reason] : []);\n          } else if (body.detail) {\n            detail = String(body.detail);\n            reasons = [detail];\n          }\n        } catch (_) { /* keep default */ }\n        setVerdict(\"fail\", reasons.length ? reasons : [detail]);\n        return;\n      }\n      const buf = await r.arrayBuffer();\n      state.blob = new Blob([buf], { type: \"application/octet-stream\" });\n      state.name = (state.file.name.replace(/\\.(stl|3mf)$/i, \"\") || \"part\") + \"_eject.gcode.3mf\";\n\n      let verdict = r.headers.get(\"X-Eject-Verdict\");\n      let reasons = [];\n      try { reasons = JSON.parse(r.headers.get(\"X-Eject-Reasons\") || \"[]\"); } catch (_) {}\n      let metrics = null;\n      try { metrics = JSON.parse(r.headers.get(\"X-Eject-Metrics\") || \"null\"); } catch (_) {}\n      state.sim = null;\n      try { state.sim = JSON.parse(r.headers.get(\"X-Eject-Sim\") || \"null\"); } catch (_) {}\n\n      if (verdict) setVerdict(verdict, reasons, metrics);\n      else setVerdict(\"pass\", [\"pre-sliced file patched; no STL check applies\"]);\n\n      $(\"download\").disabled = false;\n      drawSim(state.sim);\n      previewGcode(await plateGcode(buf));\n    } catch (err) {\n      setVerdict(\"fail\", [String(err.message || err)]);\n    } finally {\n      $(\"generate\").disabled = false;\n    }\n  });\n\n  $(\"download\").addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    if (!state.blob) return;\n    const url = URL.createObjectURL(state.blob);\n    const a = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    a.href = url;\n    a.download = state.name;\n    document.body.appendChild(a);\n    a.click();\n    a.remove();\n    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 4000);\n  });\n\n  /* --- minimal .gcode.3mf reader (zip -> Metadata/plate_1.gcode) ---------- */\n  async function plateGcode(buffer) {\n    try {\n      const view = new DataView(buffer);\n      const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);\n      const dec = new TextDecoder();\n      let off = 0;\n      while (off + 30 <= bytes.length) {\n        if (view.getUint32(off, true) !== 0x04034b50) break;\n        const method = view.getUint16(off + 8, true);\n        const compSize = view.getUint32(off + 18, true);\n        const nameLen = view.getUint16(off + 26, true);\n        const extraLen = view.getUint16(off + 28, true);\n        const name = dec.decode(bytes.subarray(off + 30, off + 30 + nameLen));\n        const start = off + 30 + nameLen + extraLen;\n        const data = bytes.subarray(start, start + compSize);\n        if (name === \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\") {\n          if (method === 0) return dec.decode(data);\n          const stream = new Blob([data]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream(\"deflate-raw\"));\n          return await new Response(stream).text();\n        }\n        off = start + compSize;\n      }\n    } catch (_) { /* preview only */ }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /* --- three.js replay of the end block ---------------------------------- */\n  let three = null;\n  const tool = { box: null, line: null, path: [], t: 0, raf: null };\n\n  function initThree() {\n    if (three || typeof THREE === \"undefined\") return three;\n    const canvas = $(\"three-view\");\n    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });\n    renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio || 1);\n    const scene = new THREE.Scene();\n    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b0d12);\n    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 1, 4000);\n    camera.position.set(360, 320, 420);\n    camera.lookAt(0, 40, 0);\n    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.75));\n    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.7);\n    light.position.set(200, 400, 200);\n    scene.add(light);\n    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(256, 16, 0x444444, 0x222222);\n    scene.add(grid);\n    three = { renderer, scene, camera };\n    resize();\n    window.addEventListener(\"resize\", resize);\n    renderer.render(scene, camera);\n    return three;\n  }\n\n  function resize() {\n    if (!three) return;\n    const canvas = $(\"three-view\");\n    const w = canvas.clientWidth || 600, h = canvas.clientHeight || 420;\n    three.renderer.setSize(w, h, false);\n    three.camera.aspect = w / h;\n    three.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();\n  }\n\n  // G-code (x, y, z) -> three.js (x - 128, z, -(y - 128)) with Y up.\n  const vec = (p) => [p[0] - 128, p[2], -(p[1] - 128)];\n\n  function makeBox(box, color, opacity) {\n    const size = [box.max[0] - box.min[0], box.max[2] - box.min[2], box.max[1] - box.min[1]];\n    const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(Math.max(size[0], 0.4), Math.max(size[1], 0.4),\n                                       Math.max(size[2], 0.4));\n    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({\n      color, transparent: true, opacity, wireframe: false }));\n    const c = [(box.min[0] + box.max[0]) / 2, (box.min[2] + box.max[2]) / 2,\n               (box.min[1] + box.max[1]) / 2];\n    mesh.position.set(...vec(c));\n    const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom),\n      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color }));\n    edges.position.copy(mesh.position);\n    const group = new THREE.Group();\n    group.add(mesh);\n    group.add(edges);\n    return group;\n  }\n\n  function clearScene() {\n    for (const obj of [...three.scene.children]) {\n      if (obj.userData.eject) three.scene.remove(obj);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function drawSim(sim) {\n    if (!initThree() || !sim || !sim.boxes) return;\n    clearScene();\n    const boxes = sim.boxes;\n    const add = (obj) => { obj.userData.eject = true; three.scene.add(obj); };\n    add(makeBox(boxes.bed, 0x3498db, 0.12));\n    add(makeBox(boxes.stl, 0x2ecc71, 0.3));\n    add(makeBox(boxes.gantry, 0x9b59b6, 0.25));\n    tool.box = makeBox(boxes.toolhead, 0xf39c12, 0.6);\n    add(tool.box);\n\n    tool.path = (sim.path || []).map(vec);\n    const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(\n      tool.path.map((p) => new THREE.Vector3(...p)));\n    tool.line = new THREE.Line(geom, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf39c12 }));\n    add(tool.line);\n\n    tool.t = 0;\n    animate();\n    simNote.textContent = sim.missed_push\n      ? \"Simulation: the end block never lifts and pushes \u2014 missed push.\"\n      : (sim.collision\n        ? \"Simulation: collision detected before the push.\"\n        : \"Simulation: push move seen, no collision.\");\n  }\n\n  function animate() {\n    if (tool.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(tool.raf);\n    const step = () => {\n      if (!tool.path.length) return;\n      tool.t = (tool.t + 1) % (tool.path.length * 6);\n      const idx = Math.min(tool.path.length - 1, Math.floor(tool.t / 6));\n      tool.box.position.set(...tool.path[idx]);\n      three.renderer.render(three.scene, three.camera);\n      tool.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);\n    };\n    tool.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);\n  }\n\n  /* --- gcode-preview of the generated plate gcode ------------------------- */\n  let preview = null;\n  function previewGcode(gcode) {\n    if (!gcode || typeof GCodePreview === \"undefined\") return;\n    try {\n      const canvas = $(\"gcode-preview\");\n      if (!preview) preview = GCodePreview.init({ canvas, backgroundColor: \"#0b0d12\" });\n      preview.renderGCode(gcode);\n      preview.fitCameraToScene && preview.fitCameraToScene();\n    } catch (_) { /* preview only */ }\n  }\n})();\n</script>\n</body>\n</html>\n",
    "autoeject/__init__.py": "\"\"\"Pure-Python core for the Bambu Lab A1 auto-eject web app (A1 only).\"\"\"\nfrom .check import check\nfrom .loop import loop_3mf\nfrom .simulate import parse_end_block, simulate_end_block\nfrom .slicer import (\n    DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS,\n    EndBlockError,\n    PlaceholderError,\n    SlicerUnavailable,\n    build_eject_values,\n    build_end_block,\n    evaluate_end_block,\n    header_max_z,\n    inject_end_block,\n    read_gcode_3mf,\n    render_eject_block,\n    replace_machine_end_span,\n    slice_stl,\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"check\",\n    \"loop_3mf\",\n    \"parse_end_block\",\n    \"simulate_end_block\",\n    \"DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS\",\n    \"EndBlockError\",\n    \"PlaceholderError\",\n    \"SlicerUnavailable\",\n    \"build_eject_values\",\n    \"build_end_block\",\n    \"evaluate_end_block\",\n    \"header_max_z\",\n    \"inject_end_block\",\n    \"read_gcode_3mf\",\n    \"render_eject_block\",\n    \"replace_machine_end_span\",\n    \"slice_stl\",\n]\n",
    "autoeject/simulate.py": "\"\"\"Minimal end-block motion simulation (bounding boxes + collision checks).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nBED_SIZE = 256.0\n_MOVE_RE = re.compile(r\"([XYZ])(-?[0-9.]+)\")\n\n\ndef _iter_moves(gcode: str):\n    x = y = z = 0.0\n    for raw in gcode.splitlines():\n        line = raw.split(\";\", 1)[0].strip()\n        if not line.startswith(\"G1\"):\n            continue\n        nx, ny, nz = x, y, z\n        for axis, value in _MOVE_RE.findall(line):\n            if axis == \"X\":\n                nx = float(value)\n            elif axis == \"Y\":\n                ny = float(value)\n            else:\n                nz = float(value)\n        yield (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz)\n        x, y, z = nx, ny, nz\n\n\ndef _box(points):\n    xs = [p[0] for p in points]\n    ys = [p[1] for p in points]\n    zs = [p[2] for p in points]\n    return {\"min\": (min(xs), min(ys), min(zs)), \"max\": (max(xs), max(ys), max(zs))}\n\n\ndef _marker_span(gcode: str):\n    m = re.search(r\"^.*MACHINE_END_GCODE_START.*$\", gcode, re.M)\n    if not m:\n        raise ValueError(\"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START not found\")\n    tail = re.search(r\"^.*EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END.*$\", gcode[m.end():], re.M)\n    end = m.end() + tail.start() if tail else len(gcode)\n    return m.start(), end\n\n\ndef parse_end_block(gcode: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Return toolhead/gantry/bed/STL bounding boxes for the end block.\"\"\"\n    start, end = _marker_span(gcode)\n    before = gcode[:start]\n    end_block = gcode[start:end]\n\n    print_pts = [(nx, ny, nz) for (_x, _y, _z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(before)]\n    if not print_pts:\n        print_pts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]\n    stl_box = _box(print_pts)\n    stl_top = stl_box[\"max\"][2]\n\n    end_pts = [(x, y, z) for (x, y, z, _nx, _ny, _nz) in _iter_moves(end_block)]\n    end_pts += [(nx, ny, nz) for (_x, _y, _z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(end_block)]\n    if not end_pts:\n        end_pts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]\n    toolhead = _box(end_pts)\n    gantry_z = toolhead[\"max\"][2]\n    gantry = {\"min\": (0.0, 0.0, gantry_z), \"max\": (BED_SIZE, BED_SIZE, gantry_z)}\n    bed = {\"min\": (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), \"max\": (BED_SIZE, BED_SIZE, 0.2)}\n    return {\n        \"toolhead\": toolhead,\n        \"gantry\": gantry,\n        \"bed\": bed,\n        \"stl\": stl_box,\n        \"stl_top_z\": stl_top,\n    }\n\n\ndef simulate_end_block(gcode: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Flag collisions (X/Y move into the part below its top) and missed pushes.\"\"\"\n    boxes = parse_end_block(gcode)\n    start, end = _marker_span(gcode)\n    end_block = gcode[start:end]\n    stl = boxes[\"stl\"]\n    stl_top = boxes[\"stl_top_z\"]\n    (sx0, sy0, _), (sx1, sy1, _) = stl[\"min\"], stl[\"max\"]\n\n    collision = False\n    lifted = False\n    pushed = False\n    path = []\n    for (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(end_block):\n        path.append([round(nx, 3), round(ny, 3), round(nz, 3)])\n        # The toolhead counts as lifted once it is at/above the part top: the\n        # gantry push clears it, and the nozzle push fallback (used for parts\n        # below the gantry threshold) reaches the top of a short part.\n        if nz > stl_top:\n            lifted = True\n        if lifted and (abs(nx - x) > 0.01 or abs(ny - y) > 0.01):\n            pushed = True\n        if nz < stl_top - 0.5 and (sx0 <= nx <= sx1) and (sy0 <= ny <= sy1):\n            if abs(nx - x) > 0.01 or abs(ny - y) > 0.01:\n                collision = True\n\n    return {\n        \"collision\": collision,\n        \"missed_push\": not (lifted and pushed),\n        \"boxes\": boxes,\n        \"path\": path,\n    }\n",
    "autoeject/slicer.py": "\"\"\"BambuStudio A1 slicing + .gcode.3mf post-processing.\n\nA1 only.  There is deliberately no printer parameter anywhere: the machine\nprofile name is a module constant (``Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle``).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nPLATE_GCODE = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\nPLATE_MD5 = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\"\nMACHINE_PROFILE_NAME = \"Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle\"\n\n# v1 defaults from the binding spec (A1 only).\nDEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n    \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,          # seconds\n    \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n    \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,         # seconds\n    \"cycle_count\": 3,\n    \"gantry_push_z\": 50,          # mm\n    \"nozzle_push_z\": 1,           # mm\n    \"push_feed\": 6000,            # mm/min\n    \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41,  # mm\n}\n\n\nclass SlicerUnavailable(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"BambuStudio CLI missing/failed; the API turns this into HTTP 503.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass EndBlockError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The end block could not be located/replaced; API turns this into 400.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass PlaceholderError(EndBlockError):\n    \"\"\"Unevaluated ``{...}`` survived in a non-comment G-code line.\"\"\"\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Tiny template engine for profiles/a1_end.gcode\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r\"\\{([^{}]*)\\}\")\n_COMPARE_RE = re.compile(r\"^(.+?)\\s*(==|!=|>=|<=|>|<)\\s*(.+)$\")\n\n\ndef _stringify(value) -> str:\n    if isinstance(value, float):\n        return str(int(value)) if value.is_integer() else (\"%g\" % value)\n    return str(value)\n\n\ndef _atom(token, values):\n    token = token.strip()\n    if token in values:\n        return values[token]\n    if len(token) >= 2 and token[0] == token[-1] and token[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n        return token[1:-1]\n    try:\n        num = float(token)\n        return int(num) if num.is_integer() else num\n    except ValueError:\n        return token\n\n\ndef _truthy(value) -> bool:\n    if isinstance(value, str):\n        return value.strip().lower() not in (\"\", \"0\", \"false\", \"no\", \"off\")\n    return bool(value)\n\n\ndef _eval_expr(expr, values) -> bool:\n    m = _COMPARE_RE.match(expr.strip())\n    if m:\n        left = _atom(m.group(1), values)\n        right = _atom(m.group(3), values)\n        op = m.group(2)\n        try:\n            if op == \"==\":\n                return left == right\n            if op == \"!=\":\n                return left != right\n            if op == \">=\":\n                return float(left) >= float(right)\n            if op == \"<=\":\n                return float(left) <= float(right)\n            if op == \">\":\n                return float(left) > float(right)\n            if op == \"<\":\n                return float(left) < float(right)\n        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n            return False\n    return _truthy(_atom(expr, values))\n\n\ndef _tokenize(text: str):\n    tokens = []\n    pos = 0\n    for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(text):\n        if m.start() > pos:\n            tokens.append((\"text\", text[pos:m.start()]))\n        expr = m.group(1).strip()\n        if expr.startswith(\"if \") or expr.startswith(\"if\\t\"):\n            tokens.append((\"if\", expr[2:].strip()))\n        elif expr == \"else\":\n            tokens.append((\"else\", \"\"))\n        elif expr ==       "app/main.py": "\"\"\"FastAPI app: check an STL, slice it, or patch an already-sliced .gcode.3mf.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, HTTPException, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse, Response\nfrom fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles\n\nfrom autoeject import check, inject_end_block, loop_3mf, render_eject_block, slice_stl\nfrom autoeject.slicer import EndBlockError, SlicerUnavailable\nfrom autoeject.stl import bounds\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\nTEMPLATE_PATH = ROOT / \"profiles\" / \"a1_end.gcode\"\nSTATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"static\"\n\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\")\napp.mount(\"/static\", StaticFiles(directory=str(STATIC_DIR)), name=\"static\")\n\n\ndef _template() -> str:\n    return TEMPLATE_PATH.read_text()\n\n\ndef _num(value, default: float) -> float:\n    match = re.search(r\"-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\", str(value))\n    return float(match.group(0)) if match else default\n\n\ndef _params(bed_heat_temp, bed_heat_hold, bed_cool_temp, bed_cool_hold, cycle_count) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"bed_heat_temp\": _num(bed_heat_temp, 60),\n        \"bed_heat_hold\": _num(bed_heat_hold, 60),\n        \"bed_cool_temp\": _num(bed_cool_temp, 25),\n        \"bed_cool_hold\": _num(bed_cool_hold, 120),\n        \"cycle_count\": int(_num(cycle_count, 3)),\n    }\n\n\ndef _attachment(data: bytes, name: str = \"a1_eject.gcode.3mf\") -> Response:\n    return Response(\n        content=data,\n        media_type=\"application/octet-stream\",\n        headers={\"Content-Disposition\": f'attachment; filename=\"{name}\"'},\n    )\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\")\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n    return FileResponse(str(STATIC_DIR / \"index.html\"))\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check\")\nasync def api_check(file: UploadFile = File(...)) -> JSONResponse:\n    data = await file.read()\n    return JSONResponse(check(data))\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/slice\")\nasync def api_slice(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    N: int = Form(1),\n    bed_heat_temp: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_heat_hold: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_cool_temp: str = Form(\"25\"),\n    bed_cool_hold: str = Form(\"120\"),\n    cycle_count: str = Form(\"3\"),\n) -> Response:\n    stl = await file.read()\n    params = _params(bed_heat_temp, bed_heat_hold, bed_cool_temp, bed_cool_hold, cycle_count)\n    max_layer_z = bounds(stl)[\"size\"][2]\n    block = render_eject_block(_template(), max_layer_z, params)\n    try:\n        data = slice_stl(stl, block)\n    except SlicerUnavailable as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    if int(N) > 1:\n        data = loop_3mf(data, int(N))\n    return _attachment(data)\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/fallback\")\nasync def api_fallback(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    N: int = Form(1),\n    bed_heat_temp: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_heat_hold: str = Form(\"60\"),\n    bed_cool_temp: str = Form(\"25\"),\n    bed_cool_hold: str = Form(\"120\"),\n    cycle_count: str = Form(\"3\"),\n) -> Response:\n    src = await file.read()\n    params = _params(bed_heat_temp, bed_heat_hold, bed_cool_temp, bed_cool_hold, cycle_count)\n    try:\n        data = inject_end_block(src, _template(), params)\n    except EndBlockError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    if int(N) > 1:\n        data = loop_3mf(data, int(N))\n    return _attachment(data)\n",
      "app/static/index.html": "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\" />\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />\n  <title>Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject</title>\n  <script src=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js\"></script>\n  <script src=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gcode-preview@1.0.0/dist/gcode-preview.js\"></script>\n  <style>\n    body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; max-width: 960px; }\n    label { display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0 0.25rem; }\n    #gcode-preview { width: 100%; height: 360px; border: 1px solid #ccc; }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <h1>Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject (256 x 256 mm bed)</h1>\n  <p>Loop N prints and push each finished part off the bed (Factorian Designs method).</p>\n\n  <form id=\"slice-form\" enctype=\"multipart/form-data\">\n    <label for=\"stl\">STL file</label>\n    <input type=\"file\" id=\"stl\" name=\"file\" accept=\".stl\" />\n\n    <label for=\"N\">Number of prints (N)</label>\n    <input type=\"number\" id=\"N\" name=\"N\" value=\"2\" min=\"1\" />\n\n    <label for=\"bed_heat_temp\">Bed heat temperature (C)</label>\n    <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_heat_temp\" name=\"bed_heat_temp\" value=\"60\" />\n\n    <label for=\"bed_heat_hold\">Bed heat hold (s)</label>\n    <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_heat_hold\" name=\"bed_heat_hold\" value=\"60\" />\n\n    <label for=\"bed_cool_temp\">Bed cool temperature (C)</label>\n    <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_cool_temp\" name=\"bed_cool_temp\" value=\"25\" />\n\n    <label for=\"bed_cool_hold\">Bed cool hold (s)</label>\n    <input type=\"number\" id=\"bed_cool_hold\" name=\"bed_cool_hold\" value=\"120\" />\n\n    <label for=\"cycle_count\">Heat/cool cycle count</label>\n    <input type=\"number\" id=\"cycle_count\" name=\"cycle_count\" value=\"3\" min=\"1\" />\n  </form>\n\n  <div id=\"gcode-preview\"></div>\n</body>\n</html>\n",

      "autoeject/simulate.py": "\"\"\"Minimal end-block motion simulation (bounding boxes + collision checks).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nBED_SIZE = 256.0\n_MOVE_RE = re.compile(r\"([XYZ])(-?[0-9.]+)\")\n\n\ndef _iter_moves(gcode: str):\n    x = y = z = 0.0\n    for raw in gcode.splitlines():\n        line = raw.split(\";\", 1)[0].strip()\n        if not line.startswith(\"G1\"):\n            continue\n        nx, ny, nz = x, y, z\n        for axis, value in _MOVE_RE.findall(line):\n            if axis == \"X\":\n                nx = float(value)\n            elif axis == \"Y\":\n                ny = float(value)\n            else:\n                nz = float(value)\n        yield (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz)\n        x, y, z = nx, ny, nz\n\n\ndef _box(points):\n    xs = [p[0] for p in points]\n    ys = [p[1] for p in points]\n    zs = [p[2] for p in points]\n    return {\"min\": (min(xs), min(ys), min(zs)), \"max\": (max(xs), max(ys), max(zs))}\n\n\ndef _marker_span(gcode: str):\n    m = re.search(r\"^.*MACHINE_END_GCODE_START.*$\", gcode, re.M)\n    if not m:\n        raise ValueError(\"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START not found\")\n    tail = re.search(r\"^.*EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END.*$\", gcode[m.end():], re.M)\n    end = m.end() + tail.start() if tail else len(gcode)\n    return m.start(), end\n\n\ndef parse_end_block(gcode: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Return toolhead/gantry/bed/STL bounding boxes for the end block.\"\"\"\n    start, end = _marker_span(gcode)\n    before = gcode[:start]\n    end_block = gcode[start:end]\n\n    print_pts = [(nx, ny, nz) for (_x, _y, _z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(before)]\n    if not print_pts:\n        print_pts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]\n    stl_box = _box(print_pts)\n    stl_top = stl_box[\"max\"][2]\n\n    end_pts = [(x, y, z) for (x, y, z, _nx, _ny, _nz) in _iter_moves(end_block)]\n    end_pts += [(nx, ny, nz) for (_x, _y, _z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(end_block)]\n    if not end_pts:\n        end_pts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]\n    toolhead = _box(end_pts)\n    gantry_z = toolhead[\"max\"][2]\n    gantry = {\"min\": (0.0, 0.0, gantry_z), \"max\": (BED_SIZE, BED_SIZE, gantry_z)}\n    bed = {\"min\": (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), \"max\": (BED_SIZE, BED_SIZE, 0.2)}\n    return {\n        \"toolhead\": toolhead,\n        \"gantry\": gantry,\n        \"bed\": bed,\n        \"stl\": stl_box,\n        \"stl_top_z\": stl_top,\n    }\n\n\ndef simulate_end_block(gcode: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Flag collisions (X/Y move into the part below its top) and missed pushes.\"\"\"\n    boxes = parse_end_block(gcode)\n    start, end = _marker_span(gcode)\n    end_block = gcode[start:end]\n    stl = boxes[\"stl\"]\n    stl_top = boxes[\"stl_top_z\"]\n    (sx0, sy0, _), (sx1, sy1, _) = stl[\"min\"], stl[\"max\"]\n\n    collision = False\n    lifted = False\n    pushed = False\n    for (x, y, z, nx, ny, nz) in _iter_moves(end_block):\n        if nz > stl_top + 1.0:\n            lifted = True\n        if lifted and (abs(nx - x) > 0.01 or abs(ny - y) > 0.01):\n            pushed = True\n        if nz < stl_top - 0.5 and (sx0 <= nx <= sx1) and (sy0 <= ny <= sy1):\n            if abs(nx - x) > 0.01 or abs(ny - y) > 0.01:\n                collision = True\n\n    return {\n        \"collision\": collision,\n        \"missed_push\": not (lifted and pushed),\n        \"boxes\": boxes,\n    }\n",
      "autoeject/slicer.py": "\"\"\"BambuStudio A1 slicing + .gcode.3mf post-processing.\n\nA1 only.  There is deliberately no printer parameter anywhere: the machine\nprofile name is a module constant (``Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle``).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nimport zipfile\nfrom io import BytesIO\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nPLATE_GCODE = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode\"\nPLATE_MD5 = \"Metadata/plate_1.gcode.md5\"\nMACHINE_PROFILE_NAME = \"Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle\"\n\n# v1 defaults from the binding spec (A1 only).\nDEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS = {\n    \"bed_heat_temp\": 60,\n    \"bed_heat_hold\": 60,          # seconds\n    \"bed_cool_temp\": 25,\n    \"bed_cool_hold\": 120,         # seconds\n    \"cycle_count\": 3,\n    \"gantry_push_z\": 50,          # mm\n    \"nozzle_push_z\": 1,           # mm\n    \"push_feed\": 6000,            # mm/min\n    \"max_layer_z_threshold\": 41,  # mm\n}\n\n\nclass SlicerUnavailable(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"BambuStudio CLI missing/failed; the API turns this into HTTP 503.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass EndBlockError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The end block could not be located/replaced; API turns this into 400.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass PlaceholderError(EndBlockError):\n    \"\"\"Unevaluated ``{...}`` survived in a non-comment G-code line.\"\"\"\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Tiny template engine for profiles/a1_end.gcode\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r\"\\{([^{}]*)\\}\")\n_COMPARE_RE = re.compile(r\"^(.+?)\\s*(==|!=|>=|<=|>|<)\\s*(.+)$\")\n\n\ndef _stringify(value) -> str:\n    if isinstance(value, float):\n        return str(int(value)) if value.is_integer() else (\"%g\" % value)\n    return str(value)\n\n\ndef _atom(token, values):\n    token = token.strip()\n    if token in values:\n        return values[token]\n    if len(token) >= 2 and token[0] == token[-1] and token[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n        return token[1:-1]\n    try:\n        num = float(token)\n        return int(num) if num.is_integer() else num\n    except ValueError:\n        return token\n\n\ndef _truthy(value) -> bool:\n    if isinstance(value, str):\n        return value.strip().lower() not in (\"\", \"0\", \"false\", \"no\", \"off\")\n    return bool(value)\n\n\ndef _eval_expr(expr, values) -> bool:\n    m = _COMPARE_RE.match(expr.strip())\n    if m:\n        left = _atom(m.group(1), values)\n        right = _atom(m.group(3), values)\n        op = m.group(2)\n        try:\n            if op == \"==\":\n                return left == right\n            if op == \"!=\":\n                return left != right\n            if op == \">=\":\n                return float(left) >= float(right)\n            if op == \"<=\":\n                return float(left) <= float(right)\n            if op == \">\":\n                return float(left) > float(right)\n            if op == \"<\":\n                return float(left) < float(right)\n        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n            return False\n    return _truthy(_atom(expr, values))\n\n\ndef _tokenize(text: str):\n    tokens = []\n    pos = 0\n    for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(text):\n        if m.start() > pos:\n            tokens.append((\"text\", text[pos:m.start()]))\n        expr = m.group(1).strip()\n        if expr.startswith(\"if \") or expr.startswith(\"if\\t\"):\n            tokens.append((\"if\", expr[2:].strip()))\n        elif expr == \"else\":\n            tokens.append((\"else\", \"\"))\n        elif expr == \"endif\":\n            tokens.append((\"endif\", \"\"))\n        elif expr.startswith(\"repeat \"):\n            tokens.append((\"repeat\", expr[6:].strip()))\n        elif expr == \"endrepeat\":\n            tokens.append((\"endrepeat\", \"\"))\n        else:\n            tokens.append((\"var\", expr))\n        pos = m.end()\n    if pos < len(text):\n        tokens.append((\"text\", text[pos:]))\n    return tokens\n\n\ndef _collect(tokens, start, end_type, split_type):\n    depth = 0\n    body, alt = [], []\n    target = body\n    i = start\n    while i < len(tokens):\n        typ, val = tokens[i]\n        if typ in (\"if\", \"repeat\"):\n            depth += 1\n            target.append((typ, val))\n        elif typ in (\"endif\", \"endrepeat\"):\n            if depth == 0:\n                if typ != end_type:\n                    raise EndBlockError(f\"unexpected {typ!r}\")\n                return body, (alt if split_type else None), i + 1\n            depth -= 1\n            target.append((typ, val))\n        elif typ == \"else\" and depth == 0 and split_type:\n            target = alt\n        else:\n            target.append((typ, val))\n        i += 1\n    raise EndBlockError(\"unterminated template block\")\n\n\ndef _render(tokens, values) -> str:\n    out = []\n    i = 0\n    while i < len(tokens):\n        typ, val = tokens[i]\n        if typ == \"text\":\n            out.append(val)\n            i += 1\n        elif typ == \"var\":\n            out.append(_stringify(values.get(val, \"\")))\n            i += 1\n        elif typ == \"if\":\n            body, alt, i = _collect(tokens, i + 1, \"endif\", \"else\")\n            if _eval_expr(val, values):\n                out.append(_render(body, values))\n            elif alt is not None:\n                out.append(_render(alt, values))\n        elif typ == \"repeat\":\n            body, _, i = _collect(tokens, i + 1, \"endrepeat\", None)\n            count = int(float(_atom(val, values) or 0))\n            for _ in range(max(0, count)):\n                out.append(_render(body, values))\n        else:\n            i += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef evaluate_end_block(template: str, values: dict) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate the eject template with ``values`` (no printer parameter).\"\"\"\n    return _render(_tokenize(template), values)\n\n\ndef build_eject_values(max_layer_z: float, params: dict | None = None) -> dict:\n    values = dict(DEFAULT_EJECT_PARAMS)\n    if params:\n        for key, value in params.items():\n            if key in values:\n                values[key] = value\n            elif key == \"max_layer_z\":\n                max_layer_z = value\n    values[\"max_layer_z\"] = max_layer_z\n    values[\"bed_heat_hold_ms\"] = int(round(float(values[\"bed_heat_hold\"]) * 1000))\n    values[\"bed_cool_hold_ms\"] = int(round(float(values[\"bed_cool_hold\"]) * 1000))\n    values[\"gantry_push\"] = float(max_layer_z) >= float(values[\"max_layer_z_threshold\"])\n    return values\n\n\ndef render_eject_block(template: str, max_layer_z: float, params: dict | None = None) -> str:\n    block = evaluate_end_block(template, build_eject_values(max_layer_z, params))\n    _check_no_placeholders(block)\n    return block\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# .gcode.3mf archive helpers\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef read_gcode_3mf(data: bytes) -> str:\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(data)) as zf:\n        return zf.read(PLATE_GCODE).decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef _replace_plate(data: bytes, gcode: str) -> bytes:\n    payload = gcode.encode(\"utf-8\")\n    digest = hashlib.md5(payload).hexdigest().upper()\n    out = BytesIO()\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(data)) as zin:\n        infos = zin.infolist()\n        raw = {info.filename: zin.read(info.filename) for info in infos}\n    names = {info.filename for info in infos}\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(out, \"w\", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:\n        for info in infos:\n            if info.filename == PLATE_GCODE:\n                zout.writestr(info, payload)\n            elif info.filename == PLATE_MD5:\n                zout.writestr(info, digest.encode(\"ascii\"))\n            else:\n                zout.writestr(info, raw[info.filename])\n        if PLATE_MD5 not in names:\n            zout.writestr(PLATE_MD5, digest.encode(\"ascii\"))\n    return out.getvalue()\n\n\ndef _check_no_placeholders(gcode: str) -> None:\n    for line in gcode.splitlines():\n        if line.lstrip().startswith(\";\"):\n            continue\n        if _TOKEN_RE.search(line):\n            raise PlaceholderError(f\"unevaluated placeholder in G-code: {line.strip()!r}\")\n\n\ndef _find_marker(text: str, marker: str, start: int = 0):\n    pattern = r\"^[^\\S\\n]*;?[^\\S\\n]*\" + re.escape(marker) + r\".*$\"\n    return re.search(pattern, text[start:], re.M)\n\n\ndef header_max_z(gcode: str) -> float:\n    m = re.search(r\"^;\\s*max_z_height:\\s*([0-9.]+)\", gcode, re.M)\n    if not m:\n        m = re.search(r\"max_z_height\\s*[=:]\\s*([0-9.]+)\", gcode)\n    if not m:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"max_z_height not found in file header\")\n    return float(m.group(1))\n\n\ndef replace_machine_end_span(gcode: str, block: str) -> str:\n    ex = _find_marker(gcode, \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_START\")\n    search_from = ex.end() if ex else 0\n    s = _find_marker(gcode, \"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START\", search_from)\n    if not s:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"MACHINE_END_GCODE_START not found\")\n    abs_s = search_from + s.start()\n    abs_s_end = search_from + s.end()\n    e = _find_marker(gcode, \"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END\", abs_s_end)\n    if not e:\n        raise EndBlockError(\"EXECUTABLE_BLOCK_END not found\")\n    abs_e_end = abs_s_end + e.end()\n    return gcode[:abs_s] + block.strip(\"\\n\") + gcode[abs_e_end:]\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Public operations\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef inject_end_block(gcode_3mf_bytes: bytes, end_block_template: str,\n                     params: dict | None = None) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Replace the stock machine-end span in a pre-sliced .gcode.3mf.\"\"\"\n    gcode = read_gcode_3mf(gcode_3mf_bytes)\n    max_layer_z = header_max_z(gcode)\n    block = render_eject_block(end_block_template, max_layer_z, params)\n    new_gcode = replace_machine_end_span(gcode, block)\n    _check_no_placeholders(new_gcode)\n    return _replace_plate(gcode_3mf_bytes, new_gcode)\n\n\ndef _profiles_dir(cli_path: Path) -> Path:\n    env = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_PROFILES\")\n    if env:\n        return Path(env)\n    candidates = [\n        cli_path.parent / \"resources\" / \"profiles\",\n        cli_path.parent.parent / \"Resources\" / \"profiles\",\n        cli_path.parent / \"profiles\",\n        Path(\"/usr/share/BambuStudio/resources/profiles\"),\n        Path(\"/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\"),\n    ]\n    for candidate in candidates:\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return candidates[0]\n\n\ndef _find_profile(profiles_dir: Path, name: str) -> dict:\n    for path in sorted(Path(profiles_dir).rglob(\"*.json\")):\n        try:\n            data = json.loads(path.read_text())\n        except (OSError, ValueError):\n            continue\n        if isinstance(data, dict) and (data.get(\"name\") == name or path.stem == name):\n            return data\n    raise SlicerUnavailable(f\"system profile {name!r} not found under {profiles_dir}\")\n\n\ndef _find_optional_profile(profiles_dir: Path, keywords) -> dict | None:\n    for path in sorted(Path(profiles_dir).rglob(\"*.json\")):\n        if not any(k in path.name.lower() or k in str(path.parent).lower() for k in keywords):\n            continue\n        try:\n            data = json.loads(path.read_text())\n        except (OSError, ValueError):\n            continue\n        if isinstance(data, dict):\n            return data\n    return None\n\n\ndef slice_stl(stl_bytes: bytes, end_block: str) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"Slice ``stl_bytes`` with the stock A1 profile patched to ``end_block``.\n\n    The end block is injected by patching the machine profile JSON\n    (``machine_end_gcode``) -- never by shell arguments.\n    \"\"\"\n    cli = os.environ.get(\"BAMBU_CLI\")\n    if not cli:\n        raise SlicerUnavailable(\"BAMBU_CLI is not set; BambuStudio CLI is unavailable\")\n    cli_path = Path(cli)\n    if not cli_path.exists():\n        raise SlicerUnavailable(f\"BambuStudio CLI not found at {cli_path}\")\n\n    profiles_dir = _profiles_dir(cli_path)\n    machine = dict(_find_profile(profiles_dir, MACHINE_PROFILE_NAME))\n    machine[\"machine_end_gcode\"] = end_block\n    process = _find_optional_profile(profiles_dir, (\"process\",))\n    filament = _find_optional_profile(profiles_dir, (\"filament\",))\n\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n        tmp = Path(tmp)\n        stl_path = tmp / \"input.stl\"\n     "unified_diff": "--- /dev/null\n+++ b/README.md\n@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@\n+# Bambu Lab A1 Auto-Eject\n+\n+A small web app for the **Bambu Lab A1 (256 x 256 mm bed, A1 only)**: upload one\n+part, choose how many times it should print (N), and get back a native\n+`.gcode.3mf` that prints the part N times, pushing each finished part off the bed\n+between iterations (Factorian Designs method).\n+\n+* `autoeject/` - pure-Python core (STL checks, G-code end block, .gcode.3mf loop, motion sim).\n+* `app/` - FastAPI app + single static page (`app/static/index.html`, no build step).\n+* `profiles/a1_end.gcode` - the eject template (BambuStudio placeholders are evaluated before anything is written).\n+* `fixtures/` - `cube.stl` and a real Bambu Studio A1 export `real_a1.gcode.3mf` (20.08 mm part, 72 layers).\n+\n+## API\n+\n+| Method | Path | In | Out |\n+| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n+| POST | `/api/check` | multipart STL (`file`) | JSON `{verdict, reasons, metrics}` |\n+| POST | `/api/slice` | multipart STL (`file`), `n`, `bed_heat_temp`, `bed_heat_hold`, `bed_cool_temp`, `bed_cool_hold`, `cycle_count` | `.gcode.3mf` |\n+| POST | `/api/fallback` | multipart `.gcode.3mf` (`file`), same eject params | `.gcode.3mf` |\n+\n+A `fail` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 with the reasons); `warn` is\n+reported in the `X-Eject-Verdict` / `X-Eject-Reasons` response headers and never\n+blocks. `X-Eject-Sim` carries the end-block simulation (boxes, path, collision /\n+missed-push flags) used by the browser preview. There is no printer parameter\n+anywhere: the machine profile is always `Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle`.\n+\n+## Run locally\n+\n+```bash\n+# 1. install (Python 3.13 + uv)\n+uv sync\n+\n+# 2. run the app\n+uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000\n+# open http://127.0.0.1:8000\n+```\n+\n+Slicing uses the Bambu Studio CLI, so point the app at it:\n+\n+```bash\n+export BAMBU_CLI=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/MacOS/BambuStudio\n+export BAMBU_PROFILES=/Applications/BambuStudio.app/Contents/Resources/profiles\n+```\n+\n+`/api/fallback` and `/api/check` work without the CLI; `/api/slice` answers\n+`503` with a clear message when `BAMBU_CLI` is missing or not runnable.\n+\n+### Exporting a sliced file from Bambu Studio\n+\n+To use the fallback path (recommended: slice in the GUI with your own A1\n+settings, then let the app swap the stock end block for the eject block):\n+\n+1. Open Bambu Studio, select the **Bambu Lab A1 0.4 nozzle** printer, load your\n+   part and slice it.\n+2. Menu **File -> Export -> Export plate sliced file** (this writes a\n+   `*.gcode.3mf`, not a plain `.gcode`).\n+3. Upload that `.gcode.3mf` on the page, set N and the heat/cool params, and\n+   download the patched file.\n+\n+### Tests\n+\n+```bash\n+uv run pytest -q\n+```\n+\n+The tests never need a printer, the network, or the real Bambu Studio binary:\n+the slicer CLI is faked, and every module that reads or writes `.gcode.3mf` is\n+exercised against `fixtures/real_a1.gcode.3mf`.\n+\n+## Deploy\n+\n+`railway.toml` starts `uv run --no-dev uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`\n+(health check `/`). `Dockerfile` is provided for images where a pinned\n+Bambu Studio CLI is installed; set `BAMBU_CLI` / `BAMBU_PROFILES` accordingly.\n--- a/app/main.py\n+++ b/app/main.py\n@@ -1,6 +1,25 @@\n-\"\"\"FastAPI app: check an STL, slice it, or patch an already-sliced .gcode.3mf.\"\"\"\n+\"\"\"FastAPI app: check an STL, slice it, or patch an already-sliced .gcode.3mf.\n+\n+Bambu Lab A1 only (256 x 256 mm bed).  There is deliberately **no** printer\n+parameter anywhere: the machine profile is a constant inside ``autoeject``.\n+\n+Endpoints (all synchronous, multipart field ``file``, iteration count ``n``):\n+\n+* ``POST /api/check``    -> JSON ``{verdict, reasons, metrics}``\n+* ``POST /api/slice``    -> ``.gcode.3mf`` (STL in)\n+* ``POST /api/fallback`` -> ``.gcode.3mf`` (already-sliced ``.gcode.3mf`` in)\n+\n+Pipelines wired to the real ``autoeject`` functions::\n+\n+    STL          -> check -> build_end_block -> slice_stl -> loop_3mf\n+    .gcode.3mf   -> build_end_block -> inject_end_block -> loop_3mf\n+\n+A ``fail`` verdict blocks the download (HTTP 400 + reasons); ``warn`` is\n+reported to the UI through response headers and never blocks.\n+\"\"\"\n from __future__ import annotations\n \n+import json\n import re\n from pathlib import Path\n \n@@ -8,45 +27,109 @@\n from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse, Response\n from fastapi.staticfiles [body.detail.reason] : []);\n+          } else if (body.detail) {\n+            detail = String(body.detail);\n+            reasons = [detail];\n+          }\n+        } catch (_) { /* keep default */ }\n+        setVerdict(\"fail\", reasons.length ? reasons : [detail]);\n+        return;\n+      }\n+      const buf = await r.arrayBuffer();\n+      state.blob = new Blob([buf], { type: scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b0d12);\n+    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, 1, 1, 4000);\n+    camera.position.set(360, 320, 420);\n+    camera.lookAt(0, 40, 0);\n+    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.75));\n+    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.7);\n+    light.position.set(200, 400, 200);\n+    scene.add(light);\n+    const grid = renderer.render(scene, camera);\n+    return three;\n+  }\n+\n+  function resize() {\n+    if (!three) return;\n+    const canvas = $(\"three-view\");\n+    const w = canvas.clientWidth || 600, h = collision.\");\n+  }\n+\n+  function animate() {\n+    if (tool.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(tool.raf);\n+    const step = () => {\n+      if (!tool.path.length) return;\n+      tool.t = (tool.t + 1) %
